note: Which kind of threat can enable which next step. Links only apply within one asset, or between assets that share a data flow or an interface. Links only run forward (disclosure, then identity, then privilege, then change or disruption), so the same two threats never appear in both orders.

links.because: disclosed data or credentials let the attacker impersonate a legitimate party
disclosed secrets can grant rights the attacker should not have
an accepted false identity lets the attacker send or change data
an accepted false identity can inherit the victim's rights
higher rights allow protected data or code to be changed
higher rights allow traces of the attack to be removed
changed records or logs hide what happened
changed data or code can stop the system working
